description:
1. Task: in the Solopreneur summary, move the Account and Wallet cards so order becomes calendar → wallet → account.
2. Solution: wrapped the layout in an outer flex-column so the Wallet+Account row sits in the DOM after the calendar column.
3. Wallet precedes Account inside a new `auto-fit` grid (2-up on desktop, stacked on mobile), preserving the sticky calendar rail.
4. Only file changed: `src/components/solopreneur/SolopreneurSummary.vue`; card markup, props, and data were untouched.
5. Result: identical desktop two-column layout with a full-width wallet/account row below, and correct stacked reading order on narrow screens.

I'll explore the existing patterns before writing code: router, stores, API modules, config maps, and reference views.## 1. Review & Understand the Task - **Implement** Solopreneur mode for `codx-junior-ui`: a view + component set, wired to the router. - **Constraint (from the approved design):** *no new API module / endpoints*. Reuse existing stores (`projects`, `chats`, `kanban`, `ui`) and existing API modules; extend only when a feature is exclusive. - **Deliverables:** `/solopreneur` top-level route, the view, its components, and the minimal wiring needed for it to render correctly in the shell. ## 2. Information Gathering — relevant findings | Area | Finding | |---|---| | Router | `src/router/index.ts`: project routes are `/:projectName/...`; `withProject()` only prefixes routes whose path contains `:projectName`. A **static** `/solopreneur` segment outranks the dynamic `/:projectName` route. | | Deep-link risk | `store/project.js` → `restoreLastActiveProject()` reads the **first URL segment** as a project name; an unknown segment redirects to `home`. `/solopreneur` must be treated as a reserved (unscoped) segment, otherwise reloads bounce to home. | | Shell | `App.vue` renders `DesktopSidebar` + ``; sidebar must be gated for the full-screen mode. | | App registry | `config/apps.js` (`APPS`) + `config/appComponentsMap.js` drive `$ui.openApp(key)` for both desktop panels and routes. | | Data available (no new endpoints) | `$chats.allChats`, `$chats.statusList/statusConfig`, `$chats.createNewChat/addMessage/saveChat/updateChatStatus/loadChats`; `$storex.kanban.allBoards / boardChats(id) / sprintBoards / sprintBoardChats(id) / noBoardChats`; `$projects.profiles`, `$projects.lastAssistantChats`; `$storex.projects.chatWihProject(chat)`; socket → `$storex.chats.onChatEvent` already reloads chats. | | Assistant pattern | `components/codx-junior/AssistantChat.vue` — create chat (`board: 'codx-junior'`) + `addMessage` + `chatWihProject`; responses arrive via socket into `$chats.chats[id]`. | | Reference view | `views/TeamView.vue` (header → stats → toolbar → content → drawer/modal) and its local `config.js` registry pattern. | ## 3. Change Proposal Solopreneur mode becomes a **projection over existing data**, not a new backend: 1. **`modules.js` registry** maps modules (Tasks, Sprints, Boards, Conversations, Ideas, Team) to existing stores, producing a uniform `item` shape. 2. **View** reads the active module from the route (`/solopreneur/:module?`) — router stays the single source of truth. 3. **Assistant panel** reuses the chats pipeline (`createNewChat` → `addMessage` → `chatWihProject`), scoped to `board: 'codx-junior'` so `$projects.lastAssistantChats` gives history for free. 4. **Item actions** delegate to existing openers: `$ui.openChat()`, `$ui.openApp('tasks'|'planning'|'team')`, `$router.push({name:'chats'})`. 5. **Wiring:** route + `APPS` entry + `appComponentsMap` + sidebar gating + reserved-segment fix in `restoreLastActiveProject`. ## 4.     return 'Backups run every night and the security scan is clean. I will flag anything that changes.'
  }
  return 'Got it. I have queued that up and will report back in your Updates feed.'
}

function sendMessage(text) {
  const value = String(text || '').trim()
  if (!value) return
  state.messages.push({ id: 'm_' + Date.now(), from: 'me', text: value, time: nowTime() })
  state.ui.typing = true
  setTimeout(() => {
    state.messages.push({ id: 'm_' + (Date.now() + 1), from: 'ai', text: pickReply(value), time: nowTime() })
    state.ui.typing = false
  }, 1100)
}

function toggleTask(id) {
  const task = state.tasks.find(x => x.id === id)
  if (!task) return
  const wasDone = task.status === 'done'
  task.status = wasDone ? 'in_progress' : 'done'
  const project = state.projects.find(p => p.name === task.context)
  if (project) project.progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, project.progress + (wasDone ? -3 : 3)))
  state.stats.tasks = Math.max(0, state.stats.tasks + (wasDone ? -1 : 1))
  closeModal()
  toast(wasDone ? t('toast.taskReopened') : t('toast.taskDone'))
}

function toggleNotifications() {
  state.user.notifications = !state.user.notifications
  toast(t('toast.saved'))
}

async function logout() {
  closeModal()
  await $storex.users.logout()
}

function setLang(code) {
  state.lang = code
  toast(t('toast.lang'))
}

function searchResults(query) {
  const q = String(query || '').trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!q) return []
  const out = []
  state.projects.forEach(p => {
    if (p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) out.push({ label: p.name, meta: 'Project', module: 'projects' })
  })
  state.tasks.forEach(x => {
    if (x.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)) out.push({ label: x.title, meta: 'Task', module: 'summary' })
  })
  state.updates.forEach(u => {
    if ((u.title + ' ' + u.text).toLowerCase().includes(q)) out.push({ label: u.title, meta: 'Update', module: 'updates' })
  })
  state.events.forEach(e => {
    if (e.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)) out.push({ label: e.title, meta: 'Calendar', module: 'summary' })
  })
  return out.slice(0, 6)
}

export function useSolopreneur() {
  return {

    PLANS,
    CREDIT_PACKS,
    t,
    money,
    shortDate,
    dateLine,
    nowTime,
    goModule,
    openModal,

    addCredits,
    changePlan,

const route = useRoute()
const { state, syncIdentity, closeModal } = useSolopreneur()

// ── Router → active module ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The route is "/solopreneur/:module?" (see src/router/index.ts). Without the
// optional segment the dashboard ("summary") is shown; unknown values fall back
// to it too, so a bad deep link never renders a blank screen.
const VIEWS = {
  summary: SolopreneurSummary,
  account: SolopreneurAccount,
  projects: SolopreneurProjects,
  wallet: SolopreneurWallet,
  updates: SolopreneurUpdates,
  messages: SolopreneurMessages
}

const activeModule = computed(() => {
  const raw = String(route.params.module || 'summary').toLowerCase()
  return MODULES.includes(raw) ? raw : 'summary'
})

const currentView = computed(() => VIEWS[activeModule.value])

// Close any open dialog when the module changes (deep link / back-forward).
watch(activeModule, () => closeModal())

// Overlay real identity (current user + active project) on the seeded profile.
onMounted(() => syncIdentity())
watch(() => $storex.projects.activeProject, () => syncIdentity())

function onKeydown(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && state.ui.modal) closeModal()
}

onMounted(() => window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown))
onBeforeUnmount(() => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown))
</script>
